# 🏔️ Leh, Ladakh — 6‑Day Trip  
> **Mumbai → Leh** · 10 Nov 2026 – 15 Nov 2026 · 1 person · Budget ₹50,000 · Estimated total ₹41,453  

## ✨ At a glance  
- **Getting there:** Air India AI‑123, ₹7,953 (economy) – Mumbai → Leh, 2 h 30 m  
- **Stay:** Hotel Palam Hills – ₹3,150/night · 3 ★ · free Wi‑Fi & breakfast, book on Booking.com  
- **Weather:** Daytime 2‑8 °C, night –5 °C; clear skies, occasional wind  
- **Total cost:** ₹41,453 of ₹50,000 budget (₹8,547 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back  
- **Go:** Air India AI‑123, Mumbai (BOM) 06:30 AM → Leh (IXL) 09:00 AM, ₹7,953 (per person)  
- **Return:** Air India AI‑124, Leh 05:00 PM → Mumbai 08:30 PM, ₹7,953 (per person)  
- **Why this option:** Direct 2½‑hour flight avoids the closed Manali‑Leh highway and is the cheapest reliable air link in the mid‑budget tier.  

## 🏨 Where to stay  
1. **Hotel Palam Hills** — ₹3,150/night · 3 ★ · free Wi‑Fi, breakfast, garden view · book on Booking.com  
2. **Grand K2 Hotel** — ₹22,000/night · 4 ★ · spa, rooftop restaurant, airport shuttle · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Hotel Karakoram** — approx. ₹2,800/night · 3 ★ · free shuttle, Wi‑Fi, garden · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day‑by‑day plan  

### Day 1 — Tue, 10 Nov · Arrival & Leh town walk  
- **06:30 AM** — Flight departs Mumbai (BOM)  
- **09:00 AM** — Arrive Leh, take prepaid airport taxi (₹500) to Hotel Palam Hills, check‑in (≈ 15 km, 30 min)  
- **10:30 AM** — Rest & acclimatise (warm tea, light snack)  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **De Khambir** — Khambir Sandwich, ₹420  
- **02:00 PM** — Stroll through **Leh Market** (free) – shop for aprons, tea, local spices  
- **04:00 PM** — Visit **Shanti Stupa** – entry free, enjoy sunset view (≈ 5 km, 15 min drive)  
- **07:00 PM** — Dinner at **Namza Dining** — Thukpa, ₹480  
- **08:30 PM** — Return to hotel, early night for altitude acclimatisation  

💡 *Tip:* Keep hydrated; avoid alcohol the first two days.  

### Day 2 — Wed, 11 Nov · Monastery circuit (shorter travel)  
- **08:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **09:00 AM** — Taxi to **Thiksey Monastery** (₹800, 45 min) – entry ₹50  
- **11:30 AM** — Return to Leh (₹800, 45 min) – brief rest  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **Zasgyath (Grand Dragon)** — Momos & Butter Tea, ₹500  
- **02:00 PM** — Taxi to **Shey Palace** (₹600, 30 min) – entry ₹50  
- **03:30 PM** — Taxi to **Hemis Monastery** (₹1,200, 2 h 30 min) – entry ₹50, explore museum  
- **06:00 PM** — Return to Leh (₹1,200, 2 h 30 min)  
- **07:30 PM** — Dinner at **Karim’s** — Yak Curry, ₹460  

💡 *Tip:* Wear sturdy shoes; monasteries have uneven stone steps.  

### Day 3 — Thu, 12 Nov · Leh acclimatisation & local sights  
- **08:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **09:30 AM** — Visit **Leh Palace** – entry ₹300, explore royal rooms (≈ 2 km, 10 min drive)  
- **11:30 AM** — Walk to **Tibetan Refugee Handicraft Centre** – free, shop for scarves & carpets (5 min walk)  
- **01:00 PM** — Lunch at **Seoul Kitchen** — Kimchi Fried Rice, ₹480  
- **02:30 PM** — Explore **Magnetic Hill** – free, short drive (≈ 12 km, 30 min) and photo stop  
- **04:30 PM** — Return to hotel, rest & hydrate  
- **07:30 PM** — Dinner at **De Khambir** — Skyu, ₹440  

💡 *Tip:* Take it easy today; your body is still adjusting to 3,500 m.  

### Day 4 — Fri, 13 Nov · Nubra Valley via Khardung La (post‑acclimatisation)  
- **07:00 AM** — Early breakfast, pack water & snacks  
- **07:30 AM** — Join shared jeep (₹2,200 round‑trip) to **Nubra Valley** via **Khardung La** (≈ 120 km, 5 h) – permit ₹300 included in jeep price  
- **12:30 PM** — Arrive in **Hunder**, lunch at local dhaba – Thukpa, ₹350  
- **01:30 PM** — Camel ride on sand dunes (₹500)  
- **02:30 PM** — Visit **Diskit Monastery** – free entry, see giant Maitreya statue  
- **04:00 PM** — Start return to Leh (≈ 5 h, 120 km)  
- **09:00 PM** — Arrive Leh, light dinner at **Sugar House** — Ladakhi Pizza, ₹520, then rest  

💡 *Tip:* Dress in layers; wind at Khardung La can be biting.  

### Day 5 — Sat, 14 Nov · Pangong Lake day‑trip (realistic travel time)  
- **06:00 AM** — Breakfast, meet tour operator (₹2,800) for **Pangong Lake** round‑trip (≈ 150 km, 7 h total) – includes driver, fuel, permit ₹200  
- **01:30 PM** — Arrive at **Pangong Tso**, walk along the lake, photo stop (free)  
- **02:00 PM** — Packed lunch (sandwich, fruit, tea) provided by tour (₹300)  
- **02:30 PM** — Depart, scenic stop at **Chang La** (entry free)  
- **08:00 PM** — Back at hotel, freshen up  
- **08:30 PM** — Farewell dinner at **Namza Dining** — Lamb Rogan Josh, ₹560  

💡 *Tip:* Carry sunglasses and sunscreen; the lake’s reflection is intense.  

### Day 6 — Sun, 15 Nov · Return to Mumbai  
- **08:00 AM** — Breakfast, check‑out, store luggage at hotel front desk  
- **09:30 AM** — Light walk to **Shops of Leh** for last‑minute souvenirs (free)  
- **11:30 AM** — Retrieve luggage, take airport taxi (₹500) to Leh Airport (≈ 15 km, 30 min)  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at airport café – Veg Thali, ₹350  
- **03:00 PM** — Arrive at gate, complete security & check‑in (recommended 2 h before flight)  
- **05:00 PM** — Flight departs Leh (AI‑124)  
- **08:30 PM** — Arrive Mumbai, end of trip  

💡 *Tip:* Keep passport, permits, and flight tickets handy for smooth check‑in.  

## 🍽️ Food to try  
- **Thukpa** at **Namza Dining** — ₹480  
- **Khambir Sandwich** at **De Khambir** — ₹420  
- **Momos & Butter Tea** at **Zasgyath** — ₹500  
- **Yak Curry** at **Karim’s** — ₹460  
- **Skyu** at **De Khambir** — ₹440  

## 💰 Budget breakdown  
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (flights) | ₹15,906 |
| Stay (5 nights @ ₹3,150) | ₹15,750 |
| Food (5 days × ₹500) | ₹2,500 |
| Local travel & activities | ₹5,297 |
| Buffer | ₹2,000 |
| **Total** | **₹41,453** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing  
- Daytime 2‑8 °C: pack thermal base layers, fleece, insulated jacket.  
- Night –5 °C: bring down‑filled jacket, gloves, woolen hat, warm socks.  
- Sunny skies: sunglasses, sunscreen SPF 30+, lip balm.  
- Good walking shoes with ankle support for rocky terrain.  

## 🏧 Useful nearby  
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – Leh Bazaar  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil, Leh‑Kargil Highway (≈ 5 km from town)  
- **Hospital:** Indira Gandhi Medical College Hospital – Leh, +91 1902‑222 222  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Leh Bus Stand (city centre), nearest railhead — Srinagar (via Zoji La)  

## 💡 Local tips  
- Acclimatise slowly; avoid strenuous hikes above 3,500 m for the first 48 h.  
- Carry a basic first‑aid kit and any personal medication; pharmacies are limited.  
- Permit for Khardung La is included in the shared‑jeep price; no extra paperwork needed.  
- Cash is king in Leh – most shops accept only INR; keep ₹10,000‑₹15,000 in small notes.  
- Respect local customs: remove shoes before entering monasteries and ask before photographing monks.
